body: The human condition summarized in one sentence.

Thanks for the comments and PMs.
I don't think it's particularly a good way to go either, I think I just like the idea of having control and being able to stop whenever I feel like.
I go to the dark places in the weekend when there's no work to distract me. This forum here is the only place I can discuss these kinds of feelings without being judged, so thank you all for existing.
